name: docparse_trace_evidence
description: Project parsed fields and tables into auditable evidence trace metadata such as page refs, bbox refs, table cells, and source snippets.

user_message.description: Original user request or short task note used for evidence trace context.

result_path.description: Workspace-local JSON result produced by document_parse or a host parser adapter.

parse_result.description: Inline parse result or projected extraction payload to trace.

required_fields.description: Field names that must appear in the evidence trace when present in the extraction result.

required_evidence.description: Structured evidence requirements such as page refs, bbox refs, snippets, table cells, or field-level provenance.
